rows.en:
"...Ee-hee-hee... That I am.
You've been waiting for me, haven't you, dearie?"{p}What do you think Sakuma said?

Hee hee hee hee."
"Uh... okay..."{p}

"...Ee-hee-hee... That I am.
You've been waiting for me, haven't you, dearie?"
"...Not really.
I was just wandering around, that's all."
This was Hara we're talking about, with her not-so-cute personality, so of course she put on a tough front.
Even so, the old lady laughed as if she could see right through her.

When Hara got home, she hurried to her room and locked the door.
"I can't wait to see everyone's surprised faces. Hee hee."
Then she slowly sucked on the candy.
A few days later...{p}

Hee hee hee..."
"Gah☆
Th-those were human eyeballs★
I ate eyeballs☆"
Sakuma felt like he was about to pass out.
"So you see, I want you to go and fetch the ingredients for me.
From now on, forever and ever."{p}

...That's the story they pass down in the basketball club.
How does anyone know it, if Tadokoro died, you ask?
Heh heh heh... What do you think happened to that notebook?
I hear it's still somewhere in the basketball club.
Though they say it's not easy to find, even if you go looking.
And what's more, there's a second volume.
Of course, as for who wrote the second one... you know, don't you?
And what was written in it, too.
The story goes that someone found it by chance and read it.
That's why this story keeps getting passed down.
You do sports, right?
I don't know what you play, but don't overdo it.{p}

Ask whether he's got some secret he's hiding.
And then, if your brother goes pale...
Heh heh heh, you'd better watch yourself too.
That's the end of my story.
Let's hear the next one.{p}

"That really scared me!
The doors just slammed shut all of a sudden!
Hey, are you all right?"
"Honestly, that was dangerous.
A girl shouldn't be left all alone with a guy in a place like a gym.
I thought my heart was going to stop.
You're cute, after all, {b}."
"Heh heh...
Did you get to meet this Tadokoro, or whatever his name was?
My, you're drenched in sweat."
Everyone was saying all sorts of things at once.
"Let's go back to the club room..."
That was all I could manage to say.{p}

Heh heh... So you want to know, huh?
You're really into this stuff, aren't you?
You just love cruel stories, is that it?
Or are you the type who loves other people's misery?
Well, whatever.
Then I'll tell you.{p}

A dark desire took hold of me.
I'd said I would do what Shindo told me, but I couldn't resist the sweet temptation.
With this book, I could pull off the perfect crime.
There was no way I wasn't going to try it.
Heh heh heh...
I grinned, hugged the book tight, and crept away...
Hm?
What's this?
A sad melody was rising up in my head...
Oh no!{p}

His thick arm caught me square in the throat.
My breath stopped.
I staggered, and he swept my legs out from under me.
I fell, and Hosoda sat astride me.
Disinfectant dripped from his hair.
Hosoda wrapped both hands around my neck and squeezed.
"Heh heh heh... Can't breathe?"
He brought his face close to mine.
At this rate, he was going to kill me.
Just then, my hand touched something hard.
I grabbed it on reflex and swung it.{p}

Iwashita grinned.
"You... You laughed when you looked at me, didn't you? That's why."
"What★"
Would anyone really want to kill someone over something like that★
Besides, I didn't remember doing any such thing.
"Heh heh... It was the day of this year's entrance ceremony. You, a new first-year, smiled at me.
But don't misunderstand. It's not as if I'm angry."
Iwashita said.
Had she read my mind?
But that only made it harder to understand.
If she wasn't angry, why kill me?
"Heh heh, you don't understand? When I saw your smile, I fell in love with you.
That's why I want you all to myself."
Iwashita was beaming at me.
That was insane.
Could anyone really fall for someone like that?
Iwashita, standing in front of me, seemed like some eerie creature.
And at that moment...{p}

"I wanted to see everyone...
I'm so lonely."
Looking at just the hand she held out, the nails were cracked and white, the skin blotched and wrinkled. It looked nothing like the hand of a seventeen-year-old.
"What lovely hair. Let me touch it..."
And what do you think she did?
She tore her classmate's hair off, scalp and all, and gently set it on her own head.
"Isn't my hair lovely?
Hee hee.
Oh, what's wrong?
You don't have any hair.
You poor thing.
I know☆
I've just had the most wonderful idea!"{p}

She grabbed the boy, who had fainted from the shock, by the legs and threw him into the incinerator right beside them, still blazing hot!
"Gyaaaaaaaargh☆"
Before the scream had even died away, she shut the door.
After about an hour, I suppose, she opened the incinerator door and raked out the ashes with a stick.
Then she gathered up the bones, still hot, and slowly began stuffing her cheeks with them, munching away.
"Bones. More bones...
Hee hee hee.
Now my illness will be cured.
I can be pretty again, just like I used to be."
Mayuko couldn't help doing a little dance of joy.{p}

"I'm glad you're better.
Look, even the flowers seem happy that you're well again, Hayasaka."
"Hee hee, do you think so?
I suppose they really did feel my heart.
Or perhaps... hee hee hee."
"What is it?"
"Hee hee hee hee. They've all grown so lively for me. I'm so happy.
For these little ones, I could do anything.
Anything at all..."{p}

Sawada began to laugh eerily and said,
"That's right. I don't have to be the sacrifice.
Heh heh heh.
Now, decide who's going to be the sacrifice."
A girl who ran away in sheer terror was turned into chunks of flesh too.
"Well? Who's it going to be?"
"Let's pick her."
"Why me?! What did I ever do?!"
After arguing it out, the girls decided who would be sacrificed.
She wept and refused, but no one would listen.{p}

"Heeelp meee!"
With a pitiful look on his face, the teacher begged Yamabe for help.
Yamabe looked at Mr. Saito and laughed under his breath.
"Heh... heh, heh heh."
He was satisfied that his plan had gone just as he wanted, and satisfied by Mr. Saito's pathetic state.
After a while, the screaming stopped.{p}

What's more, it sounded like a baby.
"Ahahaha, hee-hee-hee..."{p}

"Waaaaaaaaaaaaaah!"
With a horrible crash, Mr. Sakurai tumbled down the stairs...
As he drifted in and out of consciousness, Mr. Sakurai saw it.
A male student standing at the top of the stairs, laughing as he looked down at him...
And the teacher clearly heard what the student said.
"You're the same as me... heh heh heh."{p}

What?
You've been up on the roof, but there was nobody like that?
Heh heh heh... Well, of course not.
You can't see Aizawa under ordinary circumstances.
If you like, shall I let you meet him?
What do you say?{p}Why don't we all go up to the roof together, right now?

In the darkness, something like a cord was moving.
"Nakayama... you...!"
She was strangling his parents with a rope.
"Oh my, I said I'd tell you next time, but you just couldn't wait...?
You know, it's the best, killing people.
With animals, you were my senior, but now I'm the one ahead.
Oh, that's right.
To thank you, I'll teach you how to kill a person.
Heh heh, heh... heh..."
Morikawa tried to lunge at Nakayama.{p}

Suddenly the teacher's and Kuwahata's faces twisted into hideous masks.
"Wahaha... haha..."
"Heh heh... heh..."
The two faces laughed eerily.
"You're coming to hell with us."
That's what Kuwahata said.
Aizawa regretted it, but it was already too late.
It had been a trap.{p}

But on the way, the girls who had dumped the kitten caught her.
"So you found it, Naoko."
"Y-you were the ones who dumped it!"
"Yeah, we did.
But it's your own fault for keeping a cat at school, isn't it?"
"B-but..."
"If you don't want it dumped again, you'd better quit keeping it at school."
"Heh, heh heh heh."
They walked off, laughing.{p}

"Heh heh heh heh..."
She laughed eerily.{p}

Heh heh... So you like sci-fi and horror?
You have rather bad taste, don't you?{p}

Heh heh... How cruel you are.
With a personality like that, I won't be responsible for what becomes of you.
But Tokita was the same.
He loved movies to death, after all.
This movie might become a masterpiece for the ages.
When he thought that, he wanted to keep editing more than anything.{p}

Heh heh... You're cruel, aren't you?
With a personality like that, I won't answer for what happens to you.
But Tokita was the same.
He loved movies to death, after all.
This movie might just go down in history as a masterpiece.{p}

Suspense, is it?
I see. I quite enjoy the feeling of tension myself.
Murder stories are especially good.
The hero, sensing danger, slowly being cornered by the killer...
I just love that kind of thrill.
Heh heh heh...
Well, let's save that subject for another time.
What I'll be telling you about this time has to do with a sci-fi movie.{p}

A hallway with the lights off is frightening, isn't it?
I wonder if the teacher on patrol has already gone home.
{a}.
From here on, whatever happens, there won't be any adults to help you.
Heh heh heh...
When people say someone is reckless with their life, I suppose they mean someone like you.{p}

His face was smiling.
Is that what a skull looks like when it smiles?
It was a terribly sad smile.
And I ended up meeting Kanai's gaze.
"...Look, the doll just put its hand on your shoulder.
What's wrong?
Can't you see it, Arai?
...Looks like the doll has taken a liking to you."
I wanted to run, but my legs wouldn't obey me.
As if I'd been hypnotized, my feet just kept moving forward.
My fear reached its peak.
If I had opened my mouth, my heart would have leapt right out of it.
Kanai laughed: hee hee hee...
When he laughed, his breath puffed across my face.
And how cold that breath was...{p}

His face was smiling.
Is that what a skull looks like when it smiles?
It was a terribly sad smile.
And I ended up meeting Kanai's gaze.
"...Look, the doll just put its hand on your shoulder.
What's wrong?
Can't you see it, Arai?
...Looks like the doll has taken a liking to you."
I wanted to run, but my legs wouldn't obey me.
As if I'd been hypnotized, my feet just kept moving forward.
My fear reached its peak.
If I had opened my mouth, my heart would have leapt right out of it.
Kanai laughed: hee hee hee...
When he laughed, his breath puffed across my face.
And how cold that breath was...{p}

"You're bothered by that story earlier, aren't you?"
She grinned like a mischievous kid.
"What about you, Fukuzawa?
Weren't you the one too scared to walk home alone, so you waited for {f:me|me}?"
{f:I|I} grinned right back at her.
"Hehe... Actually, yeah.
Now that we've gotten to know each other like this, you know?
Let's go home together."{p}What {f:should|should} I do?

"So you're the last sacrifice, are you?
I thought you might be turning up about now.
Some of the sacrifices sneak into this office just before they die.
So I decided to wait.
And you turned out to be just the same.
Hee hee..."
So the principal {f:had|had} been offering a sacrifice to the devil every year to bring his son back to life.{p}

"Well, sort of. Our eyes would meet every now and then, so I thought maybe he had a crush on me. Heh heh.
So I figured he was a first-year like me, but turns out he's an upperclassman."
"Hey, {a}, maybe Arai really is a first-year."
Shindo turned to {f:me|me} as he said it.
{f:I see|Right}.
Whatever else he is, he's definitely a student at this school{f:.|.}
{f:I|I} nodded to Shindo without a word.
"Arai's a first-year?"
Fukuzawa looked puzzled.{p}

(What do I do...)
The principal swung his golf club around again, and {f:I|I} was driven back against the wardrobe.
"Heh heh heh..."
The golf club came down.
(There's nowhere left to run{f:|})
Thinking that, I shut my eyes and braced myself for the end.{p}

"{f:Look here|Heh heh}, {f:with an interview|you see, with an interview}, the key is how well you draw out the other person's story.
You can't just {f:sit there in a daze and |}listen to what they tell you.
{f:Don't you understand even|Sorry, was}{f: that much| that a bit harsh}?
...{f:Well|But}, {f:whatever|I'm not angry or anything, okay}.
{f:If you don't want to hear it|If it's all right with you}, {f:that's fine by me|I'll tell you some other time}."
...Grrr.
While {f:I|I} was at a loss, Kazama began urging everyone to get on with the next story.
"My story ends here.
{c}{f:|} said that's enough, after all.
So, whose turn is it next?"{p}

...How naive.
The Kokkuri-san I summon is the real thing.
I can summon the real Kokkuri-san.
You guys have never seen it, have you?
Heh heh heh... You can even see it, you know.
You doubt me, huh?
Well, you'll just have to wait and see.{p}

I see.
So it's about {f:woman|man} trouble, huh?
{f:You|If you}{f:'re quite the perv|want a wonderful boyfriend}, {f:heh heh heh heh...|how about me?}{p}{f:So, right now|By the way}, is there someone you like?

"Heh heh.
You're so obedient.
Good kid.
You really are a good kid."
Kazama gave a little "Heh heh" laugh.
...Wait, isn't something weird about this after {f:all|all}?
But it was already too late.
Kazama stuffed the bill into his pocket and hurried away from {f:me|me}.
Wh-what a guy.
All that talk about summoning the real Kokkuri-san, and showing it to us, and putting a curse on me... wasn't it all just to trick and scare {f:me|me} into buying an eraser{f:?|?}
...
Hino, why on earth did you invite someone like this...?
Oh...{p}

{f:Listen|I'll say this just once more}, {f:I'll say this just once more|take out a 500-yen coin}.
{f:Take out a 500-yen coin|Refuse, and you'll be sorry}.{p}{f:If you refuse...|Do you know what that means?} {f:you'll be sorry.|Heh heh heh...}

{f:The oracle says to|Whoa,} {f:express your love for her openly|it says you should confess with all your heart}.
{f:Heh heh heh|Honestly}... my, aren't you the passionate one.{p}

Mmm, splendid.
So you'll be rich someday.
{f:Our meeting here must be fate|I've felt fate between us since the moment we met}.
{f:Let's make this the start|From now on,} {f:of a beautiful friendship|let's stay very, very close}.
Heh heh heh...{p}

Heh heh.
The truth is, I've got ears like a bat.
I hea-ard it, I heard it!
I heard your se-cret!{p}

Good, good, you're a good {f:guy|girl}.
From now on, I'll take you under my wing.
If you ever have any trouble, come to me for advice.
What? You don't care about that?
You want me to hurry up and tell a scary story?
Heh heh heh... You mustn't be so impatient.{p}

Listen.
Don't be shocked.
The truth is, I'm a medium.
...Heh heh heh.{p}

...Heh heh heh, looks like you've figured it out.
You've got sharp instincts, haven't you?
You've put me in a bind.
I work so hard to hide it, and it's no fun when it gets out this quickly.{p}

...Heh heh heh, looks like you've figured it out.
You've got sharp instincts, haven't you?
You've put me in a bind.
I work so hard to hide it, and it's no fun when it gets out this quickly.
Yes, that's right.
I'm a being from another dimension, one who makes his home there.
Yes, we're called the Yapare.{p}

"Heh heh heh. I planted bombs all over the world, just in case something like this happened.
This is the switch.
They're no ordinary bombs.
They can wipe out living things, and only living things, in an instant.
With these, conquering Earth will be a simple matter."
Kazama was grinning.
He's {f:joking, right|joking, right}...?
{f:Don't make me laugh|Come on}, {f:seriously|I really want to do a serious interview}.
"Heh heh heh. You don't believe me, I see.
I can't forgive being lied to.
I was a fool to show mercy to humans like you.
I'm disillusioned.
Well then, this is goodbye.
Human life wasn't half bad."
With that, he held up the school badge.{p}

...You are a wonderful person.
Right now my whole body is trembling with tremendous emotion.
I'll follow you for the rest of my life.
I'll never, ever let you go.
Heh heh heh...
All right then, let me do your reading.{p}

"Ha ha ha ha☆ Heh heh heh heh☆"
Kazama just kept on laughing.
My tears stopped right away.
Because Kazama's behavior was just too ridiculous...{p}

...See?
Isn't it small and cute?
This one's still a baby warty toad.
Heh heh heh...
All right, let's begin.
Lord Warty Toad, Lord Warty Toad, please come to us.
If you have come, please move to 'Yes'...

Ooh-hoo-hoo...
You're a good kid.
All right, I'll ask Lord Warty Toad for you.
Lord Warty Toad, Lord Warty Toad, I beg of you.{p}

Kazama's eyes gleamed.
"Heh heh heh.
Normally, 10,000 yen plus consumption tax would come to 10,300 yen.
But as a special favor, I'll make it 10,000 yen, tax included..."
Hmph.
Wh-what a guy.{p}

Ah!
He'd already put the ten-thousand-yen bill in his pocket!
Grr, grr, grr...
"Heh heh.
Well then, shall I begin the reading?{p}

Kazama opened the club room drawer without asking and pulled out some bills.
But how did he know where the club funds were?
And on top of that, the drawer should have been locked...
"{a}.
I have spiritual powers, you see.
Heh heh heh, surprised?
Well, now that I've got a ten-thousand-yen bill, shall we begin the reading?"
...What a baffling person.
Had he heard from Hino where the newspaper club's money and key were kept, and then pulled this?
Hmmm...{p}

Katsudon, huh...
That feeling of the meat juices sizzling and spreading through your mouth.
That's the real joy of katsudon, isn't it?
I got 10,000 yen, so maybe I'll swing by the cafeteria later...
Ooh-hoo-hoo-hoo...
Now, let's continue the reading.
Your past life is gradually coming into view.
Nobody who likes katsudon is a bad person.
So you can't have been all that bad.
...That much I can already see at this point.{p}

Oden is delicious, isn't it?
But do you know what makes oden truly delicious?
The truly delicious oden is the kind you eat at the beach in summer.
Do you get what I mean?
...Oden eaten with beach babes is the best, that's what.
Ooh-hoo-hoo...
In my case, babes come up and talk to me all the time.
So I'll be enjoying a summer fling and eating oden, that sort of thing.{p}

Just be good and do as I say.
If you do, I'll take care of you personally.
Heh heh heh...
And it's also good to say this:
"I have the utmost respect for Kazama."
If you keep repeating those words, your future is as good as guaranteed.
Go on... say it.{p}

Heh heh heh...
You were a lovely, glossy, delicious-looking lobster.
Good for you.
...No, maybe that's not so good.

Your guardian spirit is... me.
A nice guy with a sweet face.
Got it?
And all of us gathered here are your guardian spirits.
You see, a person doesn't necessarily have just one guardian spirit.
Heh heh heh.

"Ha ha ha... Ah, that was fun!
{a}, I just adore you. Heh heh heh."
Kazama looked like he was truly enjoying himself.
Only his laughter rang out loud through the club room...{p}

...Heh heh, you look puzzled.
You want to ask why I came to this school after such a frightening experience... right?
I told you, didn't I? It must be fate.
For some reason, I must have been chosen by those hands.
I don't know yet what they want me to do.
But I mean to figure that out someday.
And... this is a little hard to say, though.
I can't forget how it felt to be caught by those hands.
So warm, so soft... a sense of security, like I'd become a baby again.
Someday, I want to be wrapped in those hands again...
That's my dream.
That's the end of my story.
Who's next?{p}

"Eek..."
I let out a little scream.
He brought his face close to mine and grinned.
He was panting, huff, huff, like he was excited.
His warm breath hit my face, and it was disgusting.
Then, licking his lips, he said:
"...Those girls who came with you were very tasty.
I can't taste anything myself, mind you.
But I can tell.
Because this thing... this stain ate them so happily.
It ate too much that day, even for it.
It ate four of them at once.
It got sick and threw them back up.
Blehhh, just like that.
And out they came.
Pieces of their bodies, mashed to a pulp...
With their hair all tangled up in them.
Hee-hee-hee-hee... What a waste, huh?
And it was a feast you hardly ever get to eat...
This thing loves young girls.
Since then, I've tried feeding it all sorts of things, but it still seems to like young girls best.
I wonder how it feels about boys...
You're fat, so you look like you'd make a hearty meal..."
Cold sweat ran down my back.
Like a frog stared down by a snake, I couldn't move a muscle.
"Whenever I come into this restroom, I get my appetite.
I wonder why.
This is where I can eat with the most peace of mind."{p}

Because right then, the stain twitched, as if it were reacting to her voice.
"Heh heh... This little one is happy too.
It seems to have taken a liking to you, Hosoda."
The stain had taken a liking to me...
I knew what that meant, and why the stain was happy.
Lying there on the floor, I tried to crawl away.
But she caught me right away.{p}

It was a flower growing in a flowerpot, some kind I'd never seen before.
"What is this?"
I asked him straight out.
"Heh heh.
This is my secret for never going to the restroom."
Takeuchi said it just like that.
I was a little surprised.
I wondered why he'd tell me his secret so easily.
I'd just assumed it had to be some incredible secret, like a secret technique passed down in his family and never revealed to outsiders.
"You mustn't tell anyone.
I'm only telling you because it's you, Hosoda."
When he said that, I was so happy.
I promised I'd never tell anyone.{p}

Then Takeuchi started to laugh, eerily.
His twisted face looked like a completely different person's.
"Heh heh heh heh heh...
Hosoda, you really are a gullible fool, aren't you?
It took me two years to find an idiot like you, who'd believe anything anyone told him.
Looks like I'm a good judge of people after all."
"Huh?"
Takeuchi was looking at me with an expression of utter contempt.
I had no idea at all what had just happened.
"What's wrong, Takeuchi?
Please tell me!
What's going on?"
All of a sudden, I felt uneasy.
It seemed Takeuchi had set me up.
"Oh, I'll tell you.
I've finally got a companion, so I'm in a good mood.{p}

I still can't forget how that felt.
Even now, when I close my eyes and stretch toward the sun, my consciousness slips away and I feel so happy.
After that, Takeuchi and I became really close, and we'd often stretch together in the back courtyard of the old school building.
Even now that Takeuchi's graduated, on sunny days, I stretch toward the sun.
{a}{f:|}.
I'd love to teach you this feeling, too.
It really feels so good.
Let's go behind the old school building together sometime.
I'll teach you the greatest pleasure in this world...
Heh heh heh heh heh...
Well, that's the end of my story, {a}{f:|}.
I'll come by your classroom to get you sometime.
Look forward to it.
..................
...Just now, I thought I saw something like a tentacle stretch out from around Hosoda's neck......{p}

"My, my, {a}{f:|}.
You're {f:a real coward,|quite a}{f: despite how you look| scaredy-cat}, huh?
{f:Ah|Heh}{f:... no|, heh heh}{f:, sorry|, oh}{f:, you're exactly what you look like|, that's hilarious}.
Ah ha ha ha ha!"
What {f:is|is} with this guy?!
Upperclassman or not, there's a limit to how much he can make fun of people!
{f:I|Ugh,}{f: felt like punching him right then and there, but| I want to go home already, but}{f: when I thought of| when I think of} the newspaper club's future{f:, I gritted my teeth and held back.|, I can't do that.}
{f:But|Still}{f: I got worked up, too,|, this is so unpleasant...}{f: and the words just slipped out.| Ugh!}
"Fine.
I just have to touch it, right?★"
{f:I|Fed up,}{f:| I} touched the petals in one quick motion.
In that instant☆{p}

When I slowly looked up, there was her face, smiling sweetly.
"So, how was it?
That was fun, wasn't it?"
She smiled as she said it.
She was completely back to normal.
"What on earth is going on...?"
{f:I|I} asked her.
"I just asked the spirit here to show you a fun little dream, {c}{f:|}."
"★"
She went on.
"Sometimes when I concentrate, I can make contact with spirits.
You went and said you sensed a spirit, {c}{f:|}, when you didn't believe it at all...
So I thought I'd play a little prank on you!
Tee-hee-hee!"
That's {f:insane, there's no way that really happened|ridiculous......}☆
She pointed at her wristwatch and said,
"It may have felt long, but it's only been fifteen seconds since then."
{f:I|I} went limp.
Whether what she said was a lie or the truth, it didn't matter anymore.
I just wanted to get out of here, fast.
I feel {f:sick|so sick}.{p}

But there was no longer anyone there.
...Hah... hah... hah... hah-hah-hah-hah.
What was that just now?
I wiped away the sweat streaming down my forehead.
"Hee hee hee."
"Giggle giggle."
"Heh heh heh heh heh."{p}

"All right, I sentence you to be torn limb from limb."
With that, he tied Ponkichi to a pillar so it couldn't escape and started tormenting it.
"First, we split your legs."
